title: Checkbox
description: Native checkbox with a border-drawn tick, plus indeterminate and disabled states

props.name: label
props.description: Checkbox: visible label wrapping the native input.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Checkbox: controlled mixed state; defaults to false. Update it with checked in the native onChange handler.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Checkbox: classes on the outer label. className and ref target the input; CheckboxGroup accepts native div props.
